title: Ancilla-Resolved Validation and Timing Control of Concurrent Repetition-Code Memories on a Superconducting Processor -- data and analysis
description:
Measurement data and analysis code for the manuscript Ancilla-Resolved Validation and Timing Control of Concurrent Repetition-Code Memories on a Superconducting Processor.

Fourteen hardware campaigns on an IBM Heron processor: design manifests, gate records and results, together with the per-block transition count tables and per-shot syndrome registers from which every reported statistic is computed.

python reproduce.py runs 24 checks against the published values, offline and with no quantum-computing account. Eight are recomputed from the raw counts on every run; fourteen are regenerated on request by the five scripts in analysis/; two are read from a deposited result and compared. Four further scripts in analysis/ compute the patch aggregates, the held-out prediction of the syndrome record and the higher-order statistics that the manuscript reports. MANIFEST.sha256 carries a SHA-256 for every other file.
